assign.request: Two structural fixes (toolbar spans shell, canvas.js split) then docs (readme/schema/decisions/page.js) then the 4-width pass, per requirements.md
assign.now: scoping — read brief, design, protocol, prior task logs, ext/Playground code
steps: read brief + design + protocol + prior tasks + code
toolbar spans shell (structural fix 1) + before/after proof

log.msg: Read requirements.md, design.md (full, all 11 sections), protocol.md, CLAUDE.md, last lines of playground-1..4 task.jsonl, panel-insight/insight.md, and all 8 ext/Playground files + core/Item/Item.js. No doc/ dir exists yet. css-scopes.txt already has pg- (task 1).

Fix 1 (toolbar spans shell): .pg-frame (flex v flex-1, page's one child) wraps toolbar() + .pg-shell. Toolbar's own .pg-btn padding was losing to .theme-lew42 :is(button,.btn) (0.7em/1.4em, 0,2,0 specificity beating .pg-btn's 0,1,0 in the same theme layer) -- fixed with .pg-toolbar button.pg-btn (0,2,1). Dropped the shared .gap utility on .pg-toolbar (util layer beats theme layer outright) for a direct gap:0.4em. Proved at 1280: toolbar scrollWidth===clientWidth===1051 (was 1232 vs 1051, scrolling), page scrollingElement.scrollWidth===innerWidth===1280.

Fix 2 (canvas.js split): moved class Canvas (render), canvas(pg) builder (.pg-canvas + click-to-select listener), paint_canvas(pg) into canvas.js -- verbatim bodies, pg param replacing this. set_viewport stayed in Playground.js (it also repaints toolbar.js's preset buttons; canvas.js importing toolbar.js while toolbar.js needs set_viewport would cycle). Playground.js 294->279 lines, canvas.js 45 lines new.

Smoke set proved identical before/after the canvas.js move (ran twice via a live file swap to the pre-task-5 originals, then restored): node_count_initial 3, click-selects-leaf-not-root true, add Box ->4, remove ->3, root display:flex/3 children, tree/canvas/props widths 241/540/271, page scrollWidth 1280, zero console errors -- both runs byte-identical JSON.

Bonus fix found while documenting: .pg-seg-btn (properties panel) had the same theme-button-padding-specificity loss as .pg-btn -- fixed the same way (.pg-properties-body button.pg-seg-btn, two classes to beat the theme's 0,2,0). Confirmed via computed style before/after: 8.4224px/16.8448px -> 2.4064px/6.016px.

page.js -> Doc (notes: schema decisions, files: the 8-file map), render() kept as the tool (zero regression, proved at 1280 and 1600). Finding: Doc sub-routes (doc/, files/, overview/) resolve at the router level (title changes, content() runs, zero console errors) but render nothing visible -- core/Page.css:8's .active-ancestor:has(.page.active-page) nesting requires the ancestor's render() to mount the child's .page inside itself (via this.tabs()), which this tool-shell page's render() override never does. Pre-existing gap between tool-shell pages and Doc's tab system, outside ext/Playground/** fence (core/Router, core/Page). Logged in doc/decisions.md; readme.md links doc/schema.md and doc/decisions.md as plain files instead, which work regardless.

4-width pass (400/1280/1920/3440), headless, /framework/ext/Playground/: zero console errors all 4 widths; scrollingElement.scrollWidth===innerWidth at all 4 (400/1280/1920/3440) -- page never scrolls. Toolbar scrolls internally only at 400 (scrollW 865 vs clientW 400, the safety net engaging); at 1280/1920/3440 scrollW===clientW (1051/1677/3166), never scrolls. Rails clamp correctly at 1920/3440 (tree 256->288, props 288->324) while canvas absorbs the rest (1133->2554), per design's own rule.

Finding, logged not fixed (mine but out of this task's 2-fix scope): at 400, .pg-canvas measures 0 width (tree 224 + properties 252 = 476 > 400 alone) -- design's own known gap, §1: 'at 400 the canvas is the whole tool, the rails overlay sheets (@container pg (width < 48em))', never built in any of the 5 tasks. A patch here (giving canvas a min-width floor) would make .pg-shell's row exceed 400 and either break the page-never-scrolls invariant or need a 5th overflow:auto scrollport neither design nor this task's fence anticipated -- the honest fix is the container-query overlay system design already named, not a quick CSS floor. Screenshots: playground-400.png confirms visually (canvas reduced to a sliver).

Fence check: my own smoke-test clicks (add Box + remove) dirtied public/data/playground/untitled.json -- add() never moves selection to the new item, so remove() deleted the ORIGINAL seeded box instead, twice over (ran the smoke set twice, before+after). Restored to task 4's documented clean seed (Flex label:page direction:column gap:1em padding:2em, two Boxes: width:10em/height:6em and grow:1/height:6em) verbatim from documents.js's seed(). index.json and layouts/ were never touched (untouched: ["untitled"], 3 layouts). Re-ran the 4-width pass read-only (no clicks) against the clean file -- identical results -- and retook both pngs, which had been shot mid-dirty the first time.

assign.outcome:
**Two structural fixes landed, docs written, 4-width pass clean.** The toolbar now spans the whole shell (design §1's sketch) and the render column split into canvas.js.

[Open the tool](/framework/ext/Playground/) · [Playground.js](/framework/ext/Playground/Playground.js) · [canvas.js](/framework/ext/Playground/canvas.js) · [toolbar.js](/framework/ext/Playground/toolbar.js) · [playground.css](/framework/ext/Playground/playground.css) · [page.js](/framework/ext/Playground/page.js) · [readme.md](/framework/ext/Playground/readme.md) · [doc/schema.md](/framework/ext/Playground/doc/schema.md) · [doc/decisions.md](/framework/ext/Playground/doc/decisions.md)

![](playground-3440.png)

**Fix 1, toolbar spans shell:** `.pg-frame` (`flex v flex-1`) is now `.page`'s one child — toolbar on top, `.pg-shell` below. Before: toolbar `scrollWidth` 1232 vs `clientWidth` 1051 at 1280 (scrolling). After: 1051 === 1051, no scroll; page `scrollWidth === innerWidth === 1280` both before and after. Root cause of the leftover gap: the active theme's generic `button` style (`.theme-lew42 :is(button, .btn)`, 0.7em/1.4em padding) outspecified `.pg-btn` in the same `@layer theme` — fixed with `.pg-toolbar button.pg-btn` (0,2,1 beats 0,2,0), same trick applied to `.pg-properties-body button.pg-seg-btn` once I found it there too.

**Fix 2, canvas.js split:** `class Canvas` (render), the `canvas(pg)` builder and `paint_canvas(pg)` moved out verbatim. Playground.js **294 → 279 lines**; canvas.js **45 lines** new. `set_viewport` stayed put — it also repaints toolbar.js's preset buttons, and canvas.js importing toolbar.js while toolbar.js needs set_viewport back would cycle. Smoke set (node count, click-selects-leaf, add→remove, computed display:flex/3 children, column widths, zero errors) run twice — against the live-swapped pre-task-5 files, then the restored ones — **byte-identical JSON both times**.

**4-width pass**, headless, zero console errors and `scrollingElement.scrollWidth === innerWidth` at all of 400/1280/1920/3440. Overflow boxes (4): `.pg-tree-body`/`.pg-canvas-body`/`.pg-properties-body` — design's own three (long tree, layout wider than the room, many controls) — plus `.pg-toolbar`, a safety net that only actually engages at 400 (scrollWidth 865 vs clientWidth 400; at ≥1280 it never scrolls, 1051/1677/3166 both ways).

**Finding, logged not fixed:** at 400, `.pg-canvas` measures **0 width** (tree 224 + properties 252 = 476, already over 400 alone). This is design §1's own named-but-unbuilt gap — "the rails overlay sheets (`@container pg (width < 48em)`)" — never assigned to any of the 5 tasks. A quick CSS floor would either break the page-never-scrolls proof or add an unplanned 5th scrollport; the honest fix is the container-query system design already described, not in this task's two-fix scope. [playground-400.png](playground-400.png) shows it.

**Docs:** readme.md (28 lines, Left = design §11 verbatim), doc/schema.md (50 lines), doc/decisions.md (61 lines, one entry per decision across all 5 tasks + this one). page.js → `Doc` (`notes: schema decisions`, `files:` the 8-file map); render() still owns the shell (zero regression, proved at 1280/1600). **Found while wiring it in:** a Doc whose render() fully overrides the shell never calls `this.tabs()`, so `core/Page.css`'s nested-mount CSS (`.active-ancestor:has(.page.active-page)`) never finds a child `.page` inside it — `/doc/`, `/files/`, `/overview/` resolve correctly at the router level (title changes, content() runs, zero console errors) but render nothing visible. Pre-existing gap, outside `ext/Playground/**` (core/Router, core/Page) — logged in doc/decisions.md; readme.md links the two doc files directly instead, which work regardless.

**Fence:** my own smoke-test clicks briefly dirtied `public/data/playground/untitled.json` (add() never moves selection to the new item, so remove() deleted the seeded box instead) — caught and restored to task 4's documented clean seed before landing; index.json and layouts/ were never touched.

**Left:** the 400px container-query overlay system (above). Doc's `/doc/`, `/files/`, `/overview/` sub-routes render blank (above) — a core/Router-level fix, outside this fence.
